meta.title: Kalendo – Appointments and invoicing for practices
meta.description: Online booking, calendar and simple invoicing for independent practices.

common.notFoundText: This page does not exist or is not available with your account.

home.title: Appointments, reminders and invoices in one place
home.subtitle: Kalendo replaces paper diaries, WhatsApp and spreadsheets: patients book online, get a reminder the day before, and you invoice in one click.
home.f1Text: A 3-step public page designed for mobile, with no possible double booking.
home.f2Text: Numbered PDF invoice from an attended appointment, paid / unpaid tracking, CSV export.
home.f3Text: Fill rate, no-shows and monthly revenue at a glance.
home.f4Text: French, English and Arabic (right-to-left), keyboard navigation and dark mode.
home.demoText: The "Cabinet Kiné Les Tilleuls" practice comes with one month of activity:
